editorial:
Imagine a world where your snacks start eating you back. That is the wild ride you get with this 80s gem. You follow Simon, a space archaeologist who finds a weird little creature in Peru. Things go south fast when his evil twin brother, Cecil, steals the creature to make a quick buck with his snack food business. The vibe is totally campy and chaotic, blending sci-fi weirdness with goofy horror. It feels like a fever dream from a time when movie monsters were made of rubber and glue, and it does not take itself seriously for even a second.

What really makes this work is the sheer randomness of the plot and the funny puppets. While the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the mood perfectly. The pacing is quick, and watching the creatures multiply is actually pretty satisfying. If you love old-school creature features that make you laugh, you will dig this. You should definitely try to find it for rent on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want to see those puppet effects in the best quality possible.
endingExplained: After the creatures multiply and cause total chaos in the city, the heroes have to find a way to stop the army of monsters. They eventually realize the creatures can be defeated by using their own hunger against them. Through a mix of luck and quick thinking, the main characters manage to wipe out the Munchies. The movie wraps up with the evil twin getting what he deserves, leaving you with a funny, messy conclusion.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s monster movies and goofy humor.
